title: [P0] Payment & Subscription QA — End-to-end payment flow verification
description:
## Problem
Payment flow has multiple paths (web slip upload, LINE bot, admin approve) that need thorough testing.

## Test Matrix
1. **Web payment flow**: Select plan → QR code → Upload slip → OCR auto-approve → Active
2. **Web payment flow (manual)**: Upload slip → OCR fails → Admin manual approve → Active
3. **LINE bot payment**: Purchase via LINE → credit_purchases sync → subscription active
4. **Subscription display**: Plan badge shows in header (desktop + mobile)
5. **Expiry handling**: Expired subscription → reverts to free tier
6. **Re-subscription**: Expired user → re-subscribes → active again
7. **Discord notifications**: Signup, payment, approval all fire correctly

## Acceptance
- All 7 flows pass without errors
- No edge cases where user pays but stays on free tier
- Discord notifications arrive in correct channels

- [ ] A07: Auth Failures — brute force protection, session management

- [ ] A09: Logging — security event logging
